content.text: The path is the problem, not the permission. Making it a parameter with a default in the run's scratch root, so the suite passes after this run as well as during it.

input.command:
python3 - <<'PY'
from pathlib import Path
p = Path("src/lib.sh")
t = p.read_text()
p.write_text(t.replace("    echo /var/lib/greet",
                       "    echo \"${GREET_STATE:-${TMPDIR:-/tmp}/greet}\""))
PY
